entries.title: Selective Band Control
entries.summary: Only particular bass notes or harsh midrange bursts overload an otherwise balanced mix.
tags: Multiband Dynamics; a dedicated dynamic EQ for true dynamic bell/shelf cuts

settings.back_off_when: Crossover coloration, pumping, dulled snares, or newly raised noise.

entries.title: Staged Peak Control
entries.summary: Sparse drum spikes force excessive final limiting; keep this optional on already distorted tearout.
tags: Saturator or Glue soft clip, followed by a separate Limiter in True Peak mode
steps: Start with the clipper bypassed; inspect isolated spikes and audition very small peak shaving.
Enable available high-quality/oversampling modes after inspecting the actual device; compare at equal loudness.
Follow with a separate true-peak limiter; soft clip and true peak are alternative modes on one Live Limiter, not simultaneous modes.
Set final drive by audible tolerance and external meters, not by an assumed LUFS target.

entries.title: Four-layer tearout gun
entries.summary: Combine sub, transient, body and noise with synchronized triplet rhythm.
steps: 02:18 — Triplet-grid rhythm underpins the gun pattern.
02:52 — The sub is cleaned, dispersed and processed with a tuned Corpus Kick Tight preset.
03:31 — A kick-derived transient is low-cut, frequency-shifted, distorted and shortened with transient shaping.
04:02 — The body layer uses sample-following modulation to move a filter-table position.
04:38 — A separate noise layer supplies heavily processed upper-frequency texture.
06:24 — Sub, transient, body and noise feed a shared processing group.
07:26 — Parallel low/high lanes allow the low foundation and upper texture to be treated separately.
08:52 — A parallel self-ring-modulated high-frequency lane is blended with the main signal.
09:43 — A short whole-signal delay changes timing feel; the exact millisecond value is not stated.

settings.sub: Operator sine or a cleared 808 sample; optional 808 Shaper, mono Utility, carefully tuned Corpus.
settings.transient: Short kick-derived hit into EQ Eight, Shifter, Saturator and transient shaping with Drum Buss.
settings.body: Existing FM recipe or sample; Auto Filter envelope follower for audio-reactive movement. A drawn envelope is only a rhythmic approximation.
settings.noise: Short filtered noise or textured sample; separate low-cut and restrained distortion.
settings.bus: An Audio Effect Rack can provide separate low/high processing lanes; audition and gain-match their recombination.

entries.title: Riddim square-wave FM — Operator setup
entries.summary: A concrete B-to-A Square D FM voice with sustained harmonic density, driven filtering and a separate sub.
steps: Choose the dual-pair routing shown in the cited diagrams: B into A and D into C. Silence the C/D pair.
Set A and B to Square D at a 1:1 coarse ratio; retain high B envelope sustain.
Use the MIDI gates for articulation and align FM depth/cutoff gestures with note attacks.
Add restrained drive, high-pass the texture layer and keep the sine sub separate.

native_api_recipe.method: Square D carrier/modulator at 1:1 in a B-to-A pair, high sustained modulation and a driven low-pass; separate sub required. Original riddim-oriented adaptation, not a track recreation.

movement.note: Default builder motion is periodic; manually align FM-level/cutoff gestures to MIDI attacks for a retriggered result.

entries.title: 808 Shaper — rising Drive per note
entries.summary: Raise saturation during each 808 note, reset at its end, and apply a coordinated output trim.
steps: Keep the existing kick-timed volume ducking.
Start a fresh Drive ramp at each MIDI onset and reach the peak late in the note.
Return to the low value before the next note.
Use a related output trim and compare at equal loudness before increasing wet mix.

settings.scope: Native Saturator preset named 808 Shaper. Output compensation is approximate, not a loudness measurement.

entries.title: Punchy midrange — linked FM, cutoff and vowels
entries.summary: Use contrasting note-aligned timbral gestures instead of running every modulation at the same free-running phase.
steps: For the attack, open FM depth and cutoff quickly, then decay toward a darker body.
For the response, sweep vowel position upward while a separate morph gesture emphasizes the attack.
Apply shorter, contrasting band-pass sweeps to metallic fills.
Retain rests and a clean low-frequency foundation; level-match the result.

entries.title: Found-sound layering — door, snap, demon and laser
entries.summary: Give separate layers a body, crack or attack role instead of stacking full-range sounds on every hit.
steps: Layer a short car-door impact under a snare and a dry snap above it.
Trim leading silence, align attacks, add fades and remove unnecessary low frequencies from texture layers.
Keep the mono 808 separate from distorted midrange, and use a short laser/demon composite on selected bass attacks.
Check phase, headroom and the result in context; remove layers that blur the primary hit.

settings.instance_layout: 32 main snare accents and 32 selected bass attacks. Unwarped, non-looping audio.
